local function runOp(p636, p637) -- Line: 1776
    -- upvalues: u4 (copy), call (copy), resolve (copy), replace (copy)
    local Name = u4.room.Name;

    if p636.type == "place" then
        if p637 then
            return call("RemoveItem", Name, (resolve(p636.key)));
        end;

        return replace(p636);
    end;

    if p636.type == "remove" then
        if p637 then
            return replace(p636);
        end;

        return call("RemoveItem", Name, (resolve(p636.key)));
    end;

    if p636.type == "move" then
        return call("Move", Name, resolve(p636.key), p637 and p636.from or p636.to);
    end;

    if p636.type == "swap" then
        return call("SwapItem", Name, resolve(p636.key), p637 and p636.from or p636.to);
    end;

    if p636.type == "paint" then
        return call("PaintRoom", Name, p636.kind, p637 and p636.from or p636.to);
    end;

    return false;
end;

local function floorAt(p27, p28, p29) -- Line: 67
    local bath = p27.bath;

    if bath == nil then
        bath = false;
        local Bathroom = p27.room:FindFirstChild("Bathroom");
        local v30;

        if Bathroom then
            v30 = Bathroom:FindFirstChild("TileFloor");
        else
            v30 = Bathroom;
        end;

        if v30 then
            local v31 = v30.Position.Y + v30.Size.Y / 2;

            for _, child in Bathroom:GetChildren() do
                if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name == "Checker" then
                    v31 = math.max(v31, child.Position.Y + child.Size.Y / 2);
                end;
            end;

            local v32 = (v30.CFrame - v30.Position):VectorToWorldSpace(v30.Size);
            bath = {
                xa = v30.Position.X - math.abs(v32.X) / 2,
                xb = v30.Position.X + math.abs(v32.X) / 2,
                za = v30.Position.Z - math.abs(v32.Z) / 2,
                zb = v30.Position.Z + math.abs(v32.Z) / 2,
                top = v31
            };
        end;

        p27.bath = bath;
    end;

    if bath and (bath.xa < p28 and (p28 < bath.xb and (bath.za < p29 and p29 < bath.zb))) then
        return bath.top;
    end;

    return p27.floor.Position.Y + p27.floor.Size.Y / 2;
end;

local function brushVacuum(p145, p146, p147, p148, p149) -- Line: 554

local function handFrame(p105, p106, p107) -- Line: 251
    local workspace_CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera;
    local LookVector = workspace_CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector;
    local Vector3_new_ret = Vector3.new(LookVector.X, 0, LookVector.Z);
    local CFrame_lookAt_ret = CFrame.lookAt(workspace_CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, workspace_CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position + (Vector3_new_ret.Magnitude > 0.01 and Vector3_new_ret.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)));
    local CFrame_Angles = CFrame.Angles;
    local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp(LookVector.Y, -1, 1);

    return CFrame_lookAt_ret * CFrame_Angles(math.asin(math_clamp_ret) * 0.5, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(p105, p106, p107);
end;

local function updateFlights(p563) -- Line: 1253
